title: BOSCH GO 3.0 Professional Screwdriver Kit | 9-Piece...
description: Universal Bit Locker: The universal bit locker securely holds screwdriver bits of various sizes and types. Its ¼" HEX universal bit locker can accommodate all the bits firmly, making it adaptable for different applications. LED Ring with Battery Indicator: The LED ring provides bright illumination, making it easy to work in dimly lit areas or tight spaces. In addition, it also fu nctions as a battery status indicator, displaying the tool’s remaining charge level. Torque Selection & No-load Speed: The mechanical clutch features torque settings of 5 Nm (Hard) and 2 Nm (Soft), with seven adjustable torque levels for versatility, plus a maximum performance mode. BOSCH GO 3.0 Screwdriver offers a no-load speed of 360 RPM catering to various tasks. Dual Activation and Electronic Brake Function with Smart Stop: The tool's feature enables it to be activated by either pressing it against the workpiece or by pushing a button, offering users versatile operation modes. It also ensures that the tool stops instantly when switched off and tool will cut off power after detecting the jumping which caused by misalignment between bits and screw, enhancing safety. Versatile Tool: This degree of control makes it well-suited for a range of industries, such as TV repair, laptop and desktop maintenance, mobile device repairs, electrical tasks, and furniture assembly. Warranty: The Warranty of this product is valid for 1 year from the invoice date (invoice copy needed for claims) by the brand.
